question: How do we score a forecast?
alternatives: official MAPE (denominator |actual| + 1 EUR), median per-account MAPE, MAPE on |balance| >= 100, WAPE; references: last value, 30-day median, zero
judged by: what each measure rewards; the zero forecast scores just under 100% on every MAPE
result: the official MAPE alone is decided by near-zero balances and by single accounts
decision: rank by the official MAPE, accept only without worsening the two other MAPE measures; report WAPE and the version without the largest contributor

question: Which constant level for near-zero accounts?
alternatives: 12 candidates: last value, 30-day median, weighted medians (N = 30, 60, 90, 180, 365), shrinkage (7 factors x 5 windows) and sign-uncertainty shrinkage (4 x 5) tuned on inner windows, two-step models, zero
judged by: decision rule against last value, 30-day median and zero
result: best: weighted median, tuned sign-uncertainty shrinkage (96.5% / 98.1% / 94.8%); last value 656.9% / 184.0% / 158.5%
decision: no constant level beats zero by more than one point; look for the calendar (section 8)

question: Does a sign classifier plus a size model help?
alternatives: size by absolute error (MAE) vs size by MAPE, both after a LightGBM sign classifier
judged by: decision rule against the plain weighted median
result: MAE size 287%, MAPE size 113%, weighted median N=90 104%
decision: rejected: the classifier adds nothing beyond the share of positive days

question: Can the calendar beat the zero floor?
alternatives: calendar profile, halved profile, sign gate q = 0.9, gate and factor tuned over 5 x 2 values
judged by: decision rule against zero, folds won
decision: gated profile with tuned gate for the near-zero group

question: Which stable accounts are not really stable?
alternatives: warning flag at 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 50% of the median
judged by: accounts flagged, near-zero endings caught, typical error of the accounts kept
result: at 20%: 25 flagged, 80% of endings caught, kept accounts 7.7%
decision: flag at 20%; flagged accounts go to the near-zero strategy

question: Which model for volatile accounts?
alternatives: 12 candidates: baselines, weighted medians, calendar profiles, global LightGBM with and without zeroing
judged by: decision rule against last value and 30-day median
result: best: global GBM, small forecasts zeroed (threshold tuned) (89.3% / 52.7% / 51.0%)
decision: global LightGBM with small forecasts zeroed

question: Which loss and tree size for the LightGBM?
alternatives: 5 variants: MAPE-weighted L1, 15 leaves (chosen), unweighted L1, squared loss (L2), MAPE-weighted, MAPE-weighted L1, 7 leaves, MAPE-weighted L1, 31 leaves
judged by: decision rule against the chosen configuration (raw forecasts)
result: best official MAPE: MAPE-weighted L1, 15 leaves (chosen) (93.0% / 49.6% / 49.5%)
decision: keep the MAPE-weighted L1 with 15 leaves unless a variant passes the rule

question: Do automatic tsfresh features help the LightGBM?
alternatives: the 30 most relevant of several hundred tsfresh features of the last 90 days, added to the hand-made ones
judged by: decision rule against the same model without them, raw and with small forecasts zeroed
result: not run here (RUN_TSFRESH_GBM = False); on medium, before the EUR 1 offset: 99.3% vs 97.7% official with zeroing
decision: rejected: no gain on any MAPE measure, worse WAPE, about ten more minutes per run

question: When should small GBM forecasts be set to zero?
alternatives: 6 thresholds (0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5 x typical size), tuned on the window before each cut-off
judged by: official MAPE, with the typical-account MAPE allowed to worsen by at most 10%

question: Do exponential smoothing and ARIMA help?
alternatives: ETS (additive, weekly season), ARIMA (auto, weekly season), ETS (additive, no season), ARIMA (auto, no season); fitted per account on the last year
judged by: decision rule against the baselines (and the GBM for volatile accounts), without the largest contributor
result: stable: best ARIMA (auto, no season); volatile: best classical global GBM, small forecasts zeroed (threshold tuned)
decision: stable -> ARIMA (auto, no season); volatile -> global GBM, small forecasts zeroed (threshold tuned)

question: Do the guards and a per-account choice improve the pipeline?
alternatives: no guards, guards, guards + per-account choice among last value / profile / zero
judged by: decision rule, with and without the largest contributor
decision: guards kept; per-account choice not accepted
